Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

The Government of India established a National Statistical Commission under the Chairmanship of Dr. C. Rangarajan, Governor, Andhra Pradesh vide Gazette Notification dated 19th January, 2000 whose tenure was extended initially up to 18th July, 2001.
The Government of India announce, with most profound sorrow, the death of Shri Madhavrao Scindia in a plane crash at 13-40 hours on 30th September, 2001 near Mainpuri in Uttar Pradesh.

Shrimati Phoolan Devi, an elected Member of Lok Sabhafrom Mirzapur Parliamentary Constituency of Uttar Pradesh passed away at New Delhi on 25th July, 2001 and consequently her seat in the Lok Sabha has become vacant with effect from that date.

The Central Advisory Contract Labour Board hereby dissolves the committee constituted vide the Government of India, in the Ministry of Labours Resolution No U-23013/7/98 dated 27-4-1998, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary
